card.name: Mineral property labels and 'than' after greater
card.fires_on: Words that complete a property label before a colon and value, mainly in mineral descriptions (Hardness, Specific gravity). It also fires weakly on a few words that finish a set phrase, such as 'greater than' or 'resting heart'.

modes.label: Mineral property labels
modes.description: The final word of a property name in a mineral fact list, right before a colon and number.

modes.label: Completing set phrases
modes.description: A word that completes a common phrase, such as 'greater than' in lab thresholds or 'resting heart' before rate.
